analysis: first-order linear elastic static; use full explicit stiffness; no automatic reduction

localAxes.beam: local x follows each structural DXF LINE from its start point (group codes 10/20/30) to its end point (11/21/31), reconciled across the labelled orthographic views
localAxes.2d: XZ plane; before roll local y = global +Y, local z = local x cross local y; Iy controls unrolled in-plane bending; M2 is about local y
localAxes.3d: local y = reference cross local x; local z = local x cross local y; rotation_angle applies right-hand roll about local x

notes: Report roof midpoint bending moment on both sides of the joint because the connected member can transfer a concentrated moment. Local axis 2 is global +Y; member orientation follows the labelled start and end.
planarConstraints: All nodes restrain uy, rx, rz. In-plane ux, uz, ry restraints follow the support symbols; unmarked in-plane DOFs are free.

dxfMapping.structuralLayers: Read physical members from S-BEAM/S-COLUMN lines and match S-MEMBER-TAG/S-NODE-TAG labels. A-WALL, A-COLUMN and A-EQUIPMENT outlines are nonstructural distractors, not members or connections. A-DIM and A-SUPPORT are annotations; support DOFs are specified in boundaryConditions.
dxfMapping.viewTransform: Architectural orthographic view j has CAD horizontal offset 40*j m; subtract that offset and use the named drawing axes. Structural 2D DXF maps (CAD X,CAD Y,CAD Z)=(global X,global Z,0). Structural 3D DXF uses global XYZ.
dxfMapping.connectivity: Reconcile repeated node/member labels across views into one physical graph; intersections connect only at labelled nodes. Section-detail sheets show properties and member assignments, not structural geometry.
